name: pi-code
description: Manage Pi Agent inside Visual Studio Code
author: dannycreations

virtualWorkspaces.description: Pi Code runs shell commands and reads project files from disk.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Pi Code needs a trusted workspace before it reads your project files or runs commands.

pi-code.enableTodoTool.description: Let the agent split the work into a checklist and keep it updated as it goes.

pi-code.enableAskQuestionTool.description: Let the agent stop and ask you when a request is unclear.

pi-code.enableSubagentTool.description: Let the agent hand research to a helper that reads on its own and reports back a short summary.

pi-code.enableAgentRules.description: Let the agent pick up your project instructions from AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md files.

pi-code.enableSkillDiscovery.description: Let the agent choose a skill on its own. When off, you pick the skill yourself.

pi-code.enableMcpTool.description: Let the agent use extra tools from the MCP servers you set up.

pi-code.yolo.description: Approve every agent action without asking you. Overrides the approval settings below.

pi-code.yoloRespectDenied.description: Keep blocking the paths and commands you denied, even when everything else is approved.

pi-code.autoApproveRead.description: Approve reading files without asking you.

pi-code.autoApproveSkillReads.description: Approve reading skill files without asking you. Needs Read Files approval on.

pi-code.autoApproveWrite.description: Approve creating and editing files without asking you.

pi-code.autoApproveDelete.description: Approve deleting files without asking you.

pi-code.autoApproveExecute.description: Approve running terminal commands without asking you.

pi-code.allowedReadPaths.description: Files that can be read without asking. Use * to allow every path.

pi-code.deniedReadPaths.description: Files that can never be read, even when allowed above.

pi-code.allowedWritePaths.description: Files that can be created and edited without asking. Use * to allow every path.

pi-code.deniedWritePaths.description: Files that can never be created or edited, even when allowed above.

pi-code.allowedDeletePaths.description: Files that can be deleted without asking. Use * to allow every path.

pi-code.deniedDeletePaths.description: Files that can never be deleted, even when allowed above.

pi-code.allowedExecuteCommands.description: Commands that can run without asking. Use * to allow every command.

pi-code.deniedExecuteCommands.description: Commands that can never run, even when allowed above.

pi-code.autoCompactContext.description: Shorten the conversation on your own once it grows past the limit.

pi-code.autoCompactContextPercent.description: How full the conversation has to be before it is shortened.

pi-code.maxOpenTabsContext.description: How many open tabs the agent sees. More tabs mean more detail and a higher cost.

pi-code.maxWorkspaceFiles.description: How many workspace files the agent sees. More files mean more detail and a higher cost.

pi-code.excludeIgnoredFiles.description: Skip the files your project ignores, so build output and dependencies stay out of the conversation.

pi-code.maxGitStatusFiles.description: How many changed files to show. Set to 0 to show none; the current branch always shows.

pi-code.maxToolOutputLines.description: How many lines of one result the agent gets before the rest is cut off.

pi-code.maxToolOutputSizeKb.description: How large one result can be before the agent gets it cut off.

pi-code.commitMessageModel.description: Model that writes commit messages. Leave default to use the model picked in the chat.

pi-code.commitMessageThinkingLevel.description: How much the model thinks while writing a commit message. Leave default to follow the chat.

pi-code.delegationTaskModel.description: Model that runs the tasks the agent hands off. Leave default to use the model picked in the chat.

pi-code.delegationTaskThinkingLevel.description: How much the model thinks on the tasks it hands off. Leave default to follow the chat.

pi-code.maxConcurrentFileReads.description: How many files the agent reads at once. More can be faster but uses more memory.

pi-code.maxCommandTimeoutMs.description: How long one command may run before the agent stops it.

pi-code.retryOnError.description: How many times the agent tries again when a request fails for a temporary reason.

pi-code.minTextAttachment.description: Text longer than this is sent as a file instead of pasted into the chat box.
